question: Kumar’s salary is ₹30,000 per month. He spends 25% of this on food and rent and 20% of the remaining on education. But he pays 5% of his total salary on paying the income tax and saves ₹8,000 after all these three deductions. What is the amount (in ₹.) available with him after his savings?
solution:
**Given:- **Salary = Rs. 30,000 and he spends 25% of total salary in food and rent and 20% of left salary on education

5% on tax and saves 8000

**To find:-** Total amount after saving

Calculation**:-** Salary of Kumar = Rs. 30,000 /month

Let the available amount after savings be Rs. x

According to the question, He spends his salary on different items-

⇒25% of salary + 20% of remaining salary + 5% of income tax + 8000(savings) + x= 30,000

⇒{25over 100}times 30000 + {20over 100}times (30000- (25)/(100)times 30000) + {5over 100}times 30000 + 8000(savings) + x = 30,000

⇒7500 + 4500 + 1500 + 8000 + x = 30,000

⇒x = 30,000 - 21,500

⇒x = 8500

 

**The left amount after all the deductions and saving is Rs. 8500**
